map.本工具用于检测（清洗/腐蚀/残留）服务的合法性校验，依据对应数据格式与语法规范实: This tool validates the (cleaning / corrosion / residue) testing service against the corresponding data format and syntax rules in real time, locating errors; it runs entirely in the browser and uploads no data.
map.📚 深度解析：工业清洗剂三项检测判定（清洗/腐蚀/残留）: 📚 Deep Dive: Three-Item Test for Industrial Cleaner (Cleaning / Corrosion / Residue)
map.清洗剂进场自检：按清洗效率、腐蚀速率、残留物三项判定: Cleaner incoming self-check: judge by three items — cleaning efficiency, corrosion rate, residue
map.基材保护：腐蚀速率须极低: Substrate protection: corrosion rate must be very low
map.逐项判定：清洗效率≥95%、腐蚀速率≤0.01mm/a、残留物≤5mg/dm²；: Item-by-item: cleaning efficiency ≥ 95%, corrosion rate ≤ 0.01 mm/a, residue ≤ 5 mg/dm²; all three satisfied = pass. Low corrosion rate protects substrate; low residue helps later processes.
map.清洗效率 97%（≥95 ✓）、腐蚀速率 0.005mm/a（≤0.01 ✓）、: Cleaning efficiency 97% (≥95 ✓), corrosion rate 0.005 mm/a (≤0.01 ✓), residue 3 mg/dm² (≤5 ✓): all three pass → qualified. If corrosion rate rises to 0.02 mm/a it fails, damaging the substrate.
map.0.01mm/a 极低碳钢均匀腐蚀速率（年腐蚀 0.01mm），对精密/薄壁件仍: 0.01 mm/a is an extremely low uniform-corrosion rate for carbon steel (0.01 mm per year); for precision/thin-wall parts it must be stricter — exceeding it accumulates thinning even to perforation.
map.残留多污染工件表面、影响焊接/涂装，甚至引入腐蚀；≤5mg/dm² 为常见合格上: Excess residue contaminates the surface and affects welding/coating, even introducing corrosion; ≤5 mg/dm² is a common pass upper limit.
map.清洗效率测试需标准污染试片和洗净度评定方法: Cleaning-efficiency tests require standard soiled coupons and a cleanliness rating method
map.腐蚀速率测试需称重试验前后的质量变化: Corrosion-rate tests require weighing mass change before and after the test
map.关于「检测（清洗/腐蚀/残留）服务」: About the Cleaning / Corrosion / Residue Testing Service
map.清洗剂清洗效率、腐蚀速率、残留物三项检测工具，依据GB/T 10125等标准判定: A three-item testing tool for cleaner cleaning efficiency, corrosion rate, and residue, judging pass/fail per standards such as GB/T 10125. Suitable for performance testing and quality assessment of industrial cleaners and surface-treatment agents.
map.支持清洗效率、腐蚀速率、残留物等多项指标检测: Supports testing of multiple indicators including cleaning efficiency, corrosion rate, and residue
